<!--
  Project write-up template.

  Copy this file into src/content/projects/ and rename it to the project's
  slug (e.g. a12-pipeline-crossing.md) once real project information is
  available. Delete every field you don't have real content for rather than
  guessing — docs/CONTENT.md forbids inventing project details, and every
  field below is optional in src/content.config.ts except title and summary.

  Delete this comment block before committing the real entry.
-->
---
title: "" # Required. Short, specific — e.g. "A12 Pipeline Reinstatement".
summary: "" # Required. One or two sentences, used on the /projects/ card and as the fallback SEO description.
client: "" # Optional. Omit if the client hasn't agreed to be named.
location: "" # Optional. As specific as the client is comfortable with — town/region is usually enough.
sector: "" # Optional. Matches the language used on the services pages, e.g. "Utilities", "Agriculture".
date: "" # Optional. YYYY-MM-DD. Used for sort order and shown as the completion year.
heroImage: "../../assets/Images/REPLACE-ME.webp" # Optional. Path relative to this file, matching the services pattern.
heroImageAlt: "" # Required if heroImage is set.
gallery: [] # Optional. List of image paths, same relative format as heroImage.
relatedServices: [] # Optional. e.g. [{ collection: "services", id: "tree-care" }]
relatedEquipment: [] # Optional. e.g. [{ collection: "equipment", id: "SLUG" }]
challenge: "" # Optional. What made the site or job difficult.
scopeOfWorks: "" # Optional. What was actually agreed and delivered.
solution: "" # Optional. How it was approached — equipment, sequencing, access.
result: "" # Optional. The outcome, stated plainly. No invented stats or claims.
testimonial: # Optional. Delete the whole block if there's no real quote.
  quote: ""
  author: "" # Optional.
  role: "" # Optional.
seo: # Optional. Falls back to title/summary if omitted.
  title: ""
  description: ""
---

Optional long-form body copy (renders under "Overview" on the project page).
Delete this paragraph, or the whole body, if there's nothing to add beyond
the frontmatter fields above.
